title: When Does Overriding the Majority Vote Help?
abstract: arXiv:2611.31165v1 Announce Type: new  Abstract: When should additional reasoning or verification replace a majority-vote answer? We call such a replacement an override. We examine two obstacles: the availability of correct alternatives and the reliability of methods that produce or select them. We compare additional reasoning, executed programs, and cross-model reasoning on 150 competition-mathematics questions with three open reasoning models. Starting from a majority vote over 16 responses, we measure how often overrides occur and how many errors they correct or introduce across agreement thresholds. When the vote is incorrect, the correct answer is often absent from the original responses. Additional same-model reasoning rarely overrides, while executed programs correct more errors than they introduce at every evaluated threshold. Cross-model overrides improve some weaker baselines but do not establish an advantage over the more accurate model alone, even with only eight standalone

translated_title: 何时推翻多数投票才有帮助？
translated_abstract: 何时应该用额外的推理或验证来替换多数投票给出的答案？我们将这种替换称为“推翻”（override）。我们考察了两个障碍：正确备选答案的可获得性，以及产生或选择这些答案的方法的可靠性。我们在150道竞赛数学题上，结合三个开放推理模型，比较了额外推理、执行的程序代码以及跨模型推理。从对16个回答进行的多数投票出发，我们测量了在不同一致性阈值下推翻发生的频率，以及它们纠正或引入的错误数量。研究发现：当投票结果不正确时，正确答案往往根本不在原始回答之中；额外的同模型推理很少触发推翻；而执行的程序代码在所有评估的阈值下，纠正的错误都多于其引入的错误。跨模型推翻能够改善一些较弱的基线，但即使仅使用八个独立……（原文在此截断），也无法确立相对于单独使用更准确模型的优势。
tldr: 该研究发现，在多数投票出错时，执行程序代码是唯一在所有阈值下都能净纠正错误的推翻策略，同模型额外推理几乎无效，而跨模型推翻也无法超越单独使用更强的模型。
en_tdlr: Executed programs are the only override strategy that corrects more errors than they introduce at all thresholds, while additional same-model reasoning rarely helps and cross-model overrides cannot surpass simply using the more accurate model alone.
